scope: Bounded native GOFF geometry interpolation; exact regression and scoped allocation evidence, not new independent glacier-speed accuracy or a whole-process quota.

reproduced_before_fix.reproduction_safeguard: The virtual source rejects a full read before allocating it.

fixed_behavior: Validate source axes, dimensions, units and HDF5 chunk bounds before cube reads.
Retain the exact bracketing height planes and actual target-centre spatial envelope without extrapolation.
Enforce a 64 MiB retained-float64 cube allowance, one-million-sample axis bound and 4-million-cell target bound.
Transform/interpolate targets in batches of at most 65,536 points with cancellation checkpoints.
Version the interpolation manifest and horizontal-only cache identity; retain old cached files and native originals/subsets.

geometry_read_manifest.height_source: User-specified constant ellipsoidal height; not a per-pixel DEM
geometry_read_manifest.interpolation: Trilinear on delivered height/y/x cube axes; no extrapolation
geometry_read_manifest.vector_basis: East/North/Up (ENU), verified from source dataset descriptions

source_descriptions.losUnitVectorX: East component of the line-of-sight (LOS) unit vector, defined from the target to the sensor, expressed in the east-north-up (ENU) coordinate system with its origin at the target location
source_descriptions.losUnitVectorY: North component of the line-of-sight (LOS) unit vector, defined from the target to the sensor, expressed in the east-north-up (ENU) coordinate system with its origin at the target location
source_descriptions.alongTrackUnitVectorX: East component of the along-track unit vector at the target location, expressed in the east-north-up (ENU) coordinate system and projected onto the horizontal plane (i.e., excluding the up component)
source_descriptions.alongTrackUnitVectorY: North component of the along-track unit vector at the target location, expressed in the east-north-up (ENU) coordinate system and projected onto the horizontal plane (i.e., excluding the up component)
source_descriptions.incidenceAngle: Incidence angle is defined as the angle between the LOS vector and the normal to the ellipsoid at the target height

geometry_read_manifest.resource_scope: Bounded source window and interpolation point batches; output arrays, HDF5/PROJ/SciPy overhead and the rest of the analysis are additional.

real_native_comparison.scope: Exact direct comparison with frozen 0.8.11 full-cube interpolation; timing is one local check, not a general performance guarantee.

protected_replay.other_cases: No other product reader or numerical kernel changed; earlier receipts remain historical and were not relabelled as new replays.
